attribution.documentation: implementation agent; arithmetic projection and file-hash checks of retained evidence, without new chemistry or scientific execution
attribution.independent_component: Heavy-atom graph construction, direct iterative leaf pruning and NetworkX isomorphism; shares the RDKit parser.
attribution.shared_implementation_component: Versioned project chemical-family normalization and atom/bond-aware normalized Murcko classification; an observation of production policy, not independent chemical validation of normalization.

limitations: Post hoc descriptive assessment of these saved generator outputs; not preregistered comparative efficacy evidence.
The independent graph method shares RDKit SMILES interpretation. Production family normalization and Murcko observations share project code and are not independently chemically validated here.
Bond order, charge, stereochemistry and isotopes are ignored by graph comparison. A matching graph topology does not preclude an atom/bond-aware scaffold hop.
The policy cohorts differ. Repeated seeds, rows and policies are not independent biological samples; no policy superiority, confidence interval or significance inference is made.
Raw three-row tables, configured downstream first-two inputs and final synthesis-qualified outputs are different populations. This record reports only the first two populations.

The original 630-attempt campaign was still pending at this assessment. No original pipeline failures are promoted, and no current-develop end-to-end, activity-retention, reaction-feasibility, synthesis-success or yield claim follows.

methods.count_similarity: Reported sparse-count Morgan Tanimoto scores, whose 756 old/new-arm row values were independently recalculated in the preceding index-sensitivity evaluation. The present assessment does not rerun that calculation.

independent_graph.construction: Build the undirected heavy-atom graph, retaining atomic numbers as optional vertex labels; repeatedly remove degree<2 vertices to obtain its graph 2-core.
independent_graph.element_labeled_metric: NetworkX graph isomorphism matching atomic numbers.
independent_graph.interpretation: Equal topology can accompany a heteroatom or bond-order scaffold change. The graph 2-core metrics do not replace atom/bond-aware Murcko or family identity; bond-order-only changes are invisible to both graph metrics.
independent_graph.topology_metric: NetworkX graph isomorphism without atom labels.

production_policy.definition: Versioned project chemical-family and atom/bond-aware normalized Murcko identity; candidate must retain a nonempty scaffold and differ in family and scaffold

observation_units.cohorts: Diverse covers 30 public input strings across scaffold/time/target panels; legacy covers 12 main-panel input strings. Both use seeds 42, 43 and 44. Their different input scopes do not support a direct policy-superiority comparison.
observation_units.downstream_selection: First two distinct exact candidate identities in raw table order under the frozen configuration. These are intended downstream inputs, not final synthesis-qualified outputs.
observation_units.within_policy_unique_pairs: Exact canonical isomeric query-design pairs collapse repeated seeds separately within each policy. Unique-pair summaries omit the arbitrary representative-job count. Counts are not pooled across policies as independent samples.

parent_validation_checks.input_pin_check_scope: Before and after this post hoc parent assessment of completed saved outputs; these are not before/after generator-experiment checks.

provenance.mapping_digest_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(mapping, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")); parent pins use recorded absolute paths, source mapping uses paths relative to frozen root.
provenance.publication_scope: Aggregate counts and eight molecule-free control descriptions only. Raw molecules, per-row or pair identifiers, full plans, source tables and local evaluator script are not bundled; local paths are provenance locators, not download links.

scope: Saved new-index generator outputs from the completed index-substitution diagnostic; no new generation or downstream model, synthesis or 3D run. The equal old arm is not double counted.

similarity_interpretation.configured_first_two_rows: Diverse: 90 of 180 are below 0.5. Legacy: 0 of 72 are below 0.5. These are selected generator inputs, not final synthesis-qualified outputs.
similarity_interpretation.diverse_all_raw_rows: 90 of 270 have Tanimoto <0.5; six rows have Tanimoto=1.0 and represent two unique exact query-design pairs. None is an exact input copy.
similarity_interpretation.legacy_all_raw_rows: 0 of 108 have Tanimoto <0.5; none has Tanimoto=1.0.
similarity_interpretation.limits: Fingerprint equality is not molecular identity. Neither similarity nor these graph classifications establish biological activity or synthesis success.
